question.text: Top 10 group companies/firms of the PM on turnover basis must be disclosed in the DD under:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** 'Description' section of Static Part captures promoters, directors, and top-10 group companies by turnover. **The Trap:** Group company disclosure is NOT a risk factor heading. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same disclosure pattern in III-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Refresh this list at each audited FY end; auditors cross-check it.
